description: Candidate 1 of the 2026-10-19 review. Defk.Bench.report/1 stays in lib as the user harness (docs/guides/measuring.md documents it; examples load defk via Mix.install, which compiles lib only). Move measurement hygiene (settle/0, other_cpu/0, quiet?/1, quiet_limit/0) from Bench.Cache into Defk.Bench. Move the result cache (lookup/1, store/3, cpu_model/0, key parts, file format, DEFK_BENCH_CACHE_DIR / DEFK_BENCH_SCRIPT) to dev/defk/bench/cache.ex. mix defk.examples starts each child with elixir -r dev/defk/bench/cache.ex <script>; Defk.Bench uses the cache only when Code.ensure_loaded?(Defk.Bench.Cache). DEFK_RESULT stays in Defk.Bench. Write ADR-0011 'The measurement harness ships; the scoreboard cache does not' (reason: guide + Mix.install; two adapters at the seam: none for a user, the cache for the catalog). Update bench_cache_test, scoreboard_doc_test, examples_task_test, docs/agents/runs.md, mix.exs ex_doc groups if needed. CHANGELOG entry (Defk.Bench is unstable public per ADR-0006). Deletion test: nothing in lib breaks without the adapter.

comments.text: PR #47 open: https://github.com/DanielLuning/defk/pull/47. mix ci green (2229 passed); prod compile clean with warnings as errors; seam checked end to end (stored / reused / measured without the adapter). ADR-0011 added. Ticket stays in progress until the owner merges; then bw close, bw sync, remove ../defk-x3a.1.

title: Bench: hygiene into Defk.Bench, result cache as the runner's adapter in dev/
